welcome.body: A small, friendly deck for trying the editor. Turn on Edit mode and move this slide around.
welcome.title: Welcome to the demo

signal.body: A good slide has one signal: a clear headline, a little context, and enough breathing room.
signal.title: One idea per slide

pattern.body: Use the filmstrip to reorder slides. The canvas updates immediately while the save happens in the background.
pattern.title: Edit without waiting

interaction.body: Hide a slide for a private rehearsal, then show it again. The saved state follows the presentation.
interaction.title: Visibility is part of the deck

save-protocol.body: Rapid gestures are coalesced into the newest snapshot. A revision conflict is surfaced instead of silently overwriting another editor.
save-protocol.title: Fast and safe saves

close.body: Fork this repository, replace the seed slides, and keep the edit protocol. Your own deck can start here.
close.title: Make it yours
